articles.title: IAF to indigenously produce Kamikaze drones with domestic partners
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) is actively developing indigenous long-range kamikaze drones, aiming for complete self-reliance in drone technology. This significant initiative involves inviting bids from Indian companies for the project. The move is crucial for enhancing India's defence capabilities and preparing the force for future warfare scenarios, thereby reducing dependence on foreign technology and boosting domestic manufacturing.

articles.title: retrokix added to PyPI
articles.summary: Retrokix is an innovative emulator enabling users to play Game Boy Advance and NES games. A key feature is its AI integration, making it a 'talkable' emulator for enhanced interaction and control. This technological advancement merges classic gaming with modern artificial intelligence, offering a novel way to experience retro games using standard keyboards and gamepads, highlighting progress in interactive software development.

articles.title: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy Market to Witness Significant Growth at a CAGR of 14.2% During the Forecast Period (2026-2036) as Novel Therapies Enter Late-Stage Development | DelveInsight
articles.summary: The market for chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) treatments is expanding significantly. This growth is driven by the condition's high prevalence among cancer patients and a substantial unmet medical need for effective solutions. Additionally, the increasing use of neurotoxic chemotherapies, which cause CIPN, further fuels this market, highlighting an ongoing demand for advanced medical research and patient care innovations.

articles.title: SSC Head Constable AWO/TPO answer key, response sheet 2026 released at ssc.gov.in: Direct link to download here
articles.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the answer key and response sheets for the Head Constable (Assistant Wireless Operator/Tele-Printer Operator - AWO/TPO) examination 2026. Aspirants can now access these crucial documents on the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in, to review their responses and estimate their performance. This release is a significant update for candidates awaiting their results for these national-level government posts.
